# Image attributions

## Status (2026-08-26)

`hero.jpg` and `ambiance2.jpg` are genuine Gemini generations
(generated via the `gemini-image-generator` tool), replacing the
literal OpenAI logo (a real brand mark) and a generic
Shiny-app-screenshot placeholder respectively. `ambiance3.jpg` (the
Geisel Library photo) was already genuine. `ambiance1.jpg` is also a
genuine Gemini generation as of 2026-08-26, though it is not
referenced anywhere in this post's `.qmd` body — the slot is unused.

- `hero.jpg`: a napkin sketch of a simple app layout, a pen resting
  on top, beside a closed laptop. Metaphor: a rough idea sketched out
  before being built.
- `ambiance1.jpg`: a rough clay maquette beside a finished small
  ceramic bowl. Metaphor: prototyping toward a finished product. (Not
  currently used in the post body.)
- `ambiance2.jpg`: a speech-bubble-shaped paper cutout pinned above a
  sketch of an app screen on a corkboard. Metaphor: a conversational
  interface shaping a design.

All three processed via `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85` to
1600x873.
